# Confounding resolution by 2x2 factorial

Correlated sparse signatures cannot tell "these are the same knob" from "these
happen to move the same metric". A factorial measures each parameter's effect at
both levels of the other, which separates the two.

Effect retention is why the rule tests magnitude and not only sign. A sign-only
rule passed a pair whose second member's effect collapsed from -28.0 to -0.33 —
retention 0.012. An effect that survives in sign and vanishes in magnitude is
not independently identifiable.

## Reasoning, per pair

**`opportunity.form.low` ~ `opportunity.form.high` → FREEZE_BOTH_PENDING_TARGET**

Neither main effect clears noise on any tested metric (best t -1.42018, 1.271). Nothing to separate.

**`fitBand.TRANSITION.lo` ~ `fitBand.TRANSITION.hi` → FREEZE_BOTH_PENDING_TARGET**

Neither main effect clears noise on any tested metric (best t -0.39877, 0.13698). Nothing to separate.

**`fitBand.GENERIC_HALF_COURT.lo` ~ `fitBand.GENERIC_HALF_COURT.hi` → FREEZE_BOTH_PENDING_TARGET**

Neither main effect clears noise on any tested metric (best t -1.30027, 0.65319). Nothing to separate.

**`shotLocation.rimWeight` ~ `shotLocation.rimBiasMultiplier` → KEEP_BOTH_CONTEXTUALLY_IDENTIFIED**

On locationShare:RIM, both main effects clear noise (t 76.39911 and 33.16849), and each retains its effect when the other moves (A 0.20299 to 0.20231, retention 0.99665; B 0.08832 to 0.08764, retention 0.9923). Interaction -0.00034 does not dominate. Separable.

**`shotLocation.threeWeight` ~ `shotLocation.perimeterBiasMultiplier` → FREEZE_BOTH_PENDING_TARGET**

Neither main effect clears noise on any tested metric (best t 0, 0). Nothing to separate.

**`coach.actionMixInfluence` ~ `coach.rosterSensitivity` → KEEP_BOTH_CONTEXTUALLY_IDENTIFIED**

On actionShare:PICK_AND_ROLL, both main effects clear noise (t 25.86123 and 13.63072), and each retains its effect when the other moves (A 0.0498 to 0.08946, retention 0.55667; B 0.01687 to 0.05653, retention 0.29843). Interaction 0.01983 does not dominate. Separable.

**`coach.offensiveAdjustmentMinEvents` ~ `coach.offensiveAdjustmentCooldown` → FREEZE_ONE_TUNE_ONE**

On adjustmentCount, both main effects are real but one absorbs the other: A retains 0.13433 of its effect when B moves, B retains 0.01189 (minimum 0.25). They are substitutes — either gate alone produces the effect — so coach.offensiveAdjustmentCooldown is frozen and coach.offensiveAdjustmentMinEvents carries the mechanism.
